content.value: Combining variables, input, if statements, and loops allows you to build simple interactive scripts, such as guessing games or basic calculators.

concepts.name: Program flow
concepts.description: The order in which a program’s statements execute.

concepts.name: Pseudocode
concepts.description: Plain-language or code-like planning text used to design program logic before writing exact syntax.

concepts.name: Input-process-output
concepts.description: A basic program pattern where data is received, transformed, and then displayed or returned.

concepts.name: Variable update
concepts.description: Changing the value associated with a variable during program execution.

concepts.name: Branch tracing
concepts.description: Following conditional logic step by step to determine which branch runs.

concepts.name: Loop tracing
concepts.description: Following a loop step by step to track iterations, conditions, and variable changes.
